nodes.name: Leads In (from parent workflow)
nodes.notes: Second entry point. A parent (VIO-source-leads) calls this workflow with an Execute Workflow node. inputSource=passthrough on purpose: a declared workflowInputs schema silently DROPS every field it does not list, which would strip company_domain / linkedin_url / signal on the way in.

nodes.name: Batch In (one item per lead)
nodes.notes: Fan-out ONLY. Turns whatever the parent sent (an envelope with a leads array, or N items) into exactly one item per lead, then joins the manual path at Normalize Lead. No gating happens here - there is one copy of the gates and it is downstream of this join.

assignments.name: signal
assignments.value: smoke test of the intake gate

nodes.name: Reoon Verify (power)
nodes.notes: onError=continueErrorOutput because this node now runs once PER LEAD in a batch. With the default stopWorkflow, one lead whose verification errors after 3 retries would abort the whole run and discard every lead that already succeeded. Errors leave on output 1; successes on output 0 still reach Classify, and Classify recovers each lead by the email Reoon echoes, not by item index.

parameters.query:
-- One audit row per Reoon call. lead_id is resolved by lookup so the row joins to the
-- person when they exist, and still records the address when they do not (a lead verified and then
-- dropped never gets a leads row, and the credit spent on them must still be visible).
with p as (select $1::jsonb as j)
insert into events (lead_id, lead_email, actor, action, outcome, workflow, units, est_cost_usd, payload)
select (select id from leads where vio_canon(contact_email::text) = vio_canon(p.j->>'lead_email')),
       coalesce(p.j->>'lead_email', ''),
       'reoon', 'verified',
       coalesce(p.j->>'result', ''),
       'VIO-intake-verify-curate',
       1,
       -- Left NULL while the real rate is unknown in COSTS.md. Measure, don't estimate.
       null,
       jsonb_build_object('reoon_status', p.j->>'reoon_status',
                          'source_config', p.j->>'source_config',
                          'lead_key', p.j->>'lead_id')
from p
returning id

options.queryReplacement: ={{ JSON.stringify({ lead_email: $json.lead_email || '', result: $json.result || '', reoon_status: $json.reoon_status || '', source_config: $json.source_config || '', lead_id: $json.lead_id || '' }) }}

parameters.query:
-- Upsert the person. contact_email is the natural key and carries a unique constraint,
-- so "already there" is decided by the database rather than by a read-then-write that can race.
--
-- ON CONFLICT DELIBERATELY DOES NOT TOUCH channel_state_email. That column is the lifecycle, and
-- re-running intake over someone already `enrolled` must never reset them to `not_sent` — that is a
-- second cold email to a person who has already had one. The gate skips duplicates anyway; this is
-- the guard for the day it doesn't.
with p as (select $1::jsonb as j)
insert into leads (contact_email, apollo_id, first_name, last_name, title, company, company_domain,
                   phone, linkedin_url, timezone, product, source,
                   channel_state_email, verify_action, verify_reason, reoon_status, created_by)
select vio_canon(p.j->>'contact_email'),
       nullif(p.j->>'apollo_id', ''),
       coalesce(p.j->>'first_name',''), coalesce(p.j->>'last_name',''),
       coalesce(p.j->>'title',''),      coalesce(p.j->>'company',''),
       vio_canon(coalesce(p.j->>'company_domain','')),
       coalesce(p.j->>'phone',''),      coalesce(p.j->>'linkedin_url',''),
       coalesce(p.j->>'timezone',''),
       lower(p.j->>'product')::vio_product,
       coalesce(nullif(lower(p.j->>'source'), ''), 'manual'),
       (p.j->>'channel_state_email')::vio_email_state,
       (p.j->>'verify_action')::vio_verify_verdict,
       coalesce(p.j->>'verify_reason',''), coalesce(p.j->>'reoon_status',''),
       'VIO-intake-verify-curate'
from p
on conflict (contact_email) do update set
  -- coalesce, never overwrite: a second sighting without an Apollo id must not erase the id we
  -- already paid to learn.
  apollo_id      = coalesce(excluded.apollo_id, leads.apollo_id),
  first_name     = excluded.first_name,
  last_name      = excluded.last_name,
  title          = excluded.title,
  company        = excluded.company,
  company_domain = excluded.company_domain,
  linkedin_url   = excluded.linkedin_url,
  verify_action  = excluded.verify_action,
  verify_reason  = excluded.verify_reason,
  reoon_status   = excluded.reoon_status,
  updated_at     = now()
returning id, contact_email, channel_state_email, verify_action

options.queryReplacement: ={{ JSON.stringify({ contact_email: $json.contact_email || '', apollo_id: $json.apollo_id || '', first_name: $json.first_name || '', last_name: $json.last_name || '', title: $json.title || '', company: $json.company || '', company_domain: $json.company_domain || '', phone: $json.phone || '', linkedin_url: $json.linkedin_url || '', timezone: $json.timezone || '', product: ($json.Product || $json.product || 'oryoniq'), source: ($json.source_config || 'manual'), channel_state_email: $json.channel_state_email || 'needs_review', verify_action: $json.verify_action || 'needs_review', verify_reason: $json.verify_reason || '', reoon_status: $json.reoon_status || '' }) }}

nodes.name: Skipped (duplicate / suppressed / no id)
nodes.notes: Terminal. Nothing was verified and nothing was written - the reason is on gate_reason / gate_detail in this node's input. No Reoon credit was spent.

nodes.name: Reoon Call Failed (lead left unprocessed)
nodes.notes: Terminal. Reoon errored for THIS lead after 3 retries; the rest of the batch keeps going. Deliberately writes no Events row - a call that failed is not a metered verify, and COSTS.md's rule is measure, don't estimate. The lead is not on the Leads tab, so a later run re-gates it normally.

parameters.query:
-- One question per lead, asked of the only system that knows the answer.
-- vio_canon() on BOTH sides of the dedupe: it strips zero-width characters, which the JavaScript
-- this replaces did not, so an address pasted with an invisible character no longer reads as a
-- different person.
with p as (select $1::jsonb as j)
select
  exists (
    select 1 from leads
     -- EITHER identifier is enough. The same person arrives under two addresses often enough
     -- (a work address and a role account); Apollo's id is the same both times and the email is
     -- not. The sheet checked both, so porting only the address would have quietly halved this.
     where (vio_canon(contact_email::text) = vio_canon(p.j->>'email')
            and vio_canon(p.j->>'email') <> '')
        or (apollo_id is not null and apollo_id = nullif(p.j->>'apollo_id', ''))
  ) as dupe,
  is_suppressed(
    nullif(p.j->>'email', ''),
    nullif(p.j->>'domain', ''),
    nullif(p.j->>'phone', ''),
    nullif(p.j->>'linkedin', '')
  ) as suppressed
from p

options.queryReplacement: ={{ JSON.stringify({ email: $json.email || '', domain: $json.company_domain || '', phone: $json.phone || '', linkedin: $json.linkedin_url || '', apollo_id: $json.apollo_id || '' }) }}
